operation_details.item: The user's Rep X covers the West territory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! I'm pulling together the coverage summary for our mid-year review. Could you walk me through the current territory assignments?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Sure. Rep X covers the West territory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it, West is covered by Rep X. What about the East side?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Rep Y covers the East territory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. And who handles the Central region?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Rep Z covers the Central territory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. I want to make sure our records match. Where can I confirm the full set?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Territory assignments are in the coverage map.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great, I'll reference the coverage map when I finalize the slide. Anything else on your side for the review?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Just the usual: I'd like the updated pipeline numbers by Friday.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can pull the pipeline numbers and align them with the coverage map. Should I also include forecast confidence?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, include forecast confidence by rep. It helps during the leadership review.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I'll prepare that and schedule a short check-in before the meeting.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Sounds good. I'll review it once you send it over.
